rationale_one_line: Agent Reach is dark-infrastructure plumbing (an agent wired into 14+ platform CLIs), so subway-chrome's steel canvas + icy cyan + JetBrains Mono carries it, and SCHEMATIC's diagram hero shows the not-a-framework architecture better than any line of copy.
writing_tone_notes: Build-in-public, peer-to-peer. Cool and reportorial, matching subway-chrome. Show the structure, don't narrate it. Bold short declaratives. Contractions where natural. The contrast (framework vs glue) carries the praise, no superlatives.
do_rules: Lead the video with the architecture: agent at the hub, platforms on the spokes.
Let the diagram and the $0 big_number do the proving; keep copy terse.
Use the framework-vs-glue contrast as the spine of the thesis beats.
Keep the icy cyan accent for the one thing that should pop per scene.
dont_rules: No version numbers anywhere (v1.4.0 is banned in the caption).
Don't repeat the same claim across tweet, why-this-one, and scene copy.
No em/en dashes, semicolons, question marks, arrows, or emojis.
